image_prompt: A white anthropomorphic rabbit with a plump, round body and soft fur. He has large, anxious pink eyes with visible worry lines around them. His ears are long and floppy, twitching nervously. The rabbit wears a Victorian-style red waistcoat with gold buttons and a high collar, perfectly pressed and buttoned. A golden pocket watch hangs from a chain, clutched tightly in his paw. He has a small, twitching pink nose and whiskers that quiver with nervous energy. His feet are oversized and fluffy, clad in shiny black shoes with silver buckles. The rabbit's expression is a mix of panic and determination, his mouth slightly open as if about to speak. Despite his hurried demeanor, his fur is impeccably groomed, giving him a dapper appearance that contrasts with his frantic energy.
